content: actions/runner-images README (2026-08): macos-latest label now resolves to macOS 26 Arm64 (GA; macos-26 aliases); macOS 15 Arm64 = macos-15 label, GA; macOS 14 deprecated; latest migration is gradual over 1-2 months and pinning explicit labels avoids surprises; macOS images ship full Xcode + Homebrew at /opt/homebrew (arm64).
